bull_bear.body:
- Largest manufacturer of web offset presses in India and leader in the niche 4-page newspaper offset printing press market
- Technical competence combined with a clear orientation towards customer needs, cited as the basis of its position as a supplier of choice
- Highly skilled workforce and a well-focused approach cited by the Board as drivers of its leadership position
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Substitution by digital printing — The Directors' Report notes that digital printing is growing, while arguing offset stays relevant for large print runs and lower cost per unit — leaving the Company's press demand exposed to that shift in printing technology.
- Concentration in a single niche product and end-market — The Company is described as the largest manufacturer of web offset presses in India and leader in the niche 4-page newspaper offset printing press market, so earnings depend on demand from newspaper and localized print media rather than a diversified product base.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

outlook.body:
- Continued demand expected in the Indian newspaper offset printing machine industry in 2025-26, driven by the need for high-volume, cost-effective printing solutions, particularly for regional and localized news
- Offset printing remains relevant despite growth in digital printing, due to its efficiency in large print runs and lower cost per unit
- Demand for localized print media in South Asia (including India) expected to remain strong, driving the need for offset printing machines
- Government institutions and educational bodies rely on offset printing for public bulletins, examination papers and other materials, contributing to ongoing demand
